---
title: "GB7CAM Network Graph (Stable Model)"
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
execute:
  echo: false
---

<div style="display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:center; margin-bottom:10px;">
  <label>
    <input type="checkbox" id="opMode">
    Operator Mode (full registry)
  </label>

  <label>
    <input type="checkbox" id="showHub" checked>
    Show Core Hub (GB7CAM)
  </label>

  <input id="filter" placeholder="filter node e.g. GB7FCI" />
</div>

<div id="cy" style="width:100%; height:90vh; border:1px solid #ddd;"></div>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/cytoscape@3.26.0/dist/cytoscape.min.js"></script>

<script>

const API = "https://api.gb7cam.org.uk/graph";

let cy;
let fullData = null;

/* ---------------------------
   PORT COLOUR MODEL (truth)
----------------------------*/
function portColor(port) {
  switch(String(port)) {
    case "1": return "#2ca02c"; // RF
    case "2": return "#ffbf00"; // TELNET
    case "3": return "#1f77b4"; // AXIP
    default:  return "#999999";
  }
}

/* ---------------------------
   NODE LABEL (NO TYPE GUESSING)
----------------------------*/
function label(n) {
  return n.alias && n.alias.length > 0
    ? `${n.id}\n${n.alias}`
    : n.id;
}

/* ---------------------------
   CORE HUB HANDLING
----------------------------*/
function isHub(id) {
  return id === "GB7CAM";
}

/* ---------------------------
   BUILD SAFE GRAPH
----------------------------*/
function buildGraph(data) {

  const nodes = new Map();

  // registry nodes
  for (const n of data.nodes) {
    nodes.set(n.id, {
      data: {
        id: n.id,
        label: label(n),
        kind: "node"
      }
    });
  }

  const edges = [];

  for (const e of data.edges) {

    // NEVER infer missing nodes as real nodes
    if (!nodes.has(e.source)) {
      nodes.set(e.source, {
        data: {
          id: e.source,
          label: e.source,
          kind: "unknown"
        }
      });
    }

    if (!nodes.has(e.target)) {
      nodes.set(e.target, {
        data: {
          id: e.target,
          label: e.target,
          kind: "unknown"
        }
      });
    }

    edges.push({
      data: {
        source: e.source,
        target: e.target,
        port: e.port || "3",
        quality: e.quality || 0
      }
    });
  }

  return [...nodes.values(), ...edges];
}

/* ---------------------------
   NODE COLOUR (ONLY HUB + UNKNOWN)
----------------------------*/
function nodeColor(node) {

  const id = node.data('id');

  if (isHub(id)) return "#111111";   // core hub black
  if (node.data('kind') === "unknown") return "#aaaaaa";

  return "#4c4c4c";
}

/* ---------------------------
   RENDER
----------------------------*/
function render(data) {

  const elements = buildGraph(data);

  cy = cytoscape({
    container: document.getElementById('cy'),

    elements,

    layout: {
      name: 'cose',
      animate: true,
      fit: true,
      padding: 40
    },

    style: [

      /* NODES */
      {
        selector: 'node',
        style: {
          'label': 'data(label)',
          'font-size': 10,
          'text-wrap': 'wrap',
          'text-valign': 'center',
          'text-halign': 'center',

          'background-color': ele => nodeColor(ele),

          'width': 28,
          'height': 28,

          'border-width': 1,
          'border-color': '#ccc'
        }
      },

      /* EDGES */
      {
        selector: 'edge',
        style: {
          'curve-style': 'bezier',

          'line-color': ele => portColor(ele.data('port')),
          'target-arrow-color': ele => portColor(ele.data('port')),
          'target-arrow-shape': 'triangle',

          'width': ele => Math.max(1, (ele.data('quality') || 0) / 60),

          'opacity': 0.85
        }
      }

    ]
  });

  setupUI();
}

/* ---------------------------
   FILTER + OP MODE
----------------------------*/
function setupUI() {

  const filter = document.getElementById("filter");
  const opMode = document.getElementById("opMode");
  const showHub = document.getElementById("showHub");

  function apply() {

    const f = filter.value.toUpperCase();
    const op = opMode.checked;
    const hub = showHub.checked;

    cy.nodes().forEach(n => {

      const id = n.id().toUpperCase();
      const label = (n.data('label') || "").toUpperCase();

      let visible = true;

      /* filter */
      if (f && !(id.includes(f) || label.includes(f))) {
        visible = false;
      }

      /* hub toggle */
      if (!hub && isHub(n.id())) {
        visible = false;
      }

      /* operator mode = show full registry only */
      if (!op && n.data('kind') === "unknown") {
        visible = false;
      }

      n.style("display", visible ? "element" : "none");
    });

    cy.edges().forEach(e => {

      const s = e.source().style("display");
      const t = e.target().style("display");

      e.style("display",
        (s === "element" && t === "element")
          ? "element"
          : "none"
      );
    });
  }

  filter.addEventListener("input", apply);
  opMode.addEventListener("change", apply);
  showHub.addEventListener("change", apply);
}

/* ---------------------------
   LOAD
----------------------------*/
fetch(API)
  .then(r => r.json())
  .then(data => render(data))
  .catch(err => {
    console.error(err);
    document.getElementById("cy").innerHTML =
      "<p style='color:red'>Graph load failed</p>";
  });

</script>
